theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_cfs_radial_homotopy
theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ q • (β (t • y)).curryLeft y) x + (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • (exteriorDerivative β (t • x)).curryLeft x) = β x
